This is my only 200h & 300h Teacher Training in Europe. Set in the serene Mediterranean eco-retreat Agricola Samadhi @yogainsalento .  
For one transformative month, you’ll deepen your personal practice and rediscover yoga as a complete, living system.  
Expect to be challenged in how you think about yoga and breathing. You'll unlock new levels of strength, energy, and understanding of your body. [...] By diving into my 5-Dimensional Synergy Flow, rooted in the traditional systems of India, China, and Tibet, you'll learn how to embody yoga in a truly integrated way.  
This is not just another modern training. It’s a month of embodied study guided entirely by Simon Borg-Olivier, yoga master and physiotherapist.  
🗓️ 9 May – 6 June 2026  
📍 Salento, Italy (Agricola Samadhi / Yoga in Salento)  
💸 Early Bird EXTENDED untill 31st January 2026  
Spaces are limited and this training will sell out.

Cortemaggiore, Emilia-Romagna - Global Leadership Retreat 2026  
Our Master of Leadership students spent three transformative days at Hotel La Tavola Rotonda — a restored 13th-century castle in the Italian countryside — for the centrepiece of their programme. [...] Not a conference. Not a seminar. A fully immersive, residential experience designed to move leadership development from the academic into the deeply personal.  
Over three days, participants were challenged, stretched, and supported to engage with one fundamental question: Who do you want to be as a leader?  
The setting was deliberate. Leadership does not develop in comfort — it emerges in environments that demand clarity, presence, and intention. This is where it became real.

This hybrid format allows you to complete 100 hours online at your own pace, followed by a 14 day in person immersion in Provence. The on site training takes place at a private retreat center surrounded by nature, offering a focused and supportive learning environment.  
The program covers asana, pranayama, meditation, anatomy, philosophy, sequencing, and teaching practice. You will graduate with a Yoga Alliance certification and the confidence to teach internationally.
